simple.meaning: שׁוּר (shûwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a wall (as going about).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שׁוּר (H7791) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:22, with occurrences in Genesis, 2 Samuel, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוּר (H7791) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שׁוּר (H7791) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שׁוּר (shûwr) / H7791 is traced through Genesis 49:22, 2 Samuel 22:30, Job 24:11, Psalms 18:30 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H7791. shur II. שׁוּר noun [masculine] wall (Aramaic שׁוּרָא , ); — Gen 49:22 (poem in J), 2Sam 22:30 = Psa 18:30 ; plural suffix שׁוּרֹתָם Job 24:11 their walls De Di De, compare Bu; but see שׁוּרָה infra; שָׁרוֺתֶיהָ Jer 5:10 = its walls , according to Vrss AV RV Gf Gie, read then ׳שֻׁ , but see id. [ שׁוּרָה ] noun feminine probably row of olives or vines (so Du Buhl and others; compare Late Hebrew שׁוּרָה , Jewish-Aramaic שׁוּרְתָא row , whence modern Arabic as loan-word, compare Vogelst Land wirthschaft 41 f. ); — plural suffix שׁוּרֹתְם Job 24:11 (al. II. שׁוּר ); Bu and Du strike out suffix; here also Jer 5:10 (reading ׳שֻׁ ) Du Buhl Dr, her (vine-) rows , but see II. שׁוּר . שַׁוְשָׁא proper name, masculine 1Chr 18:16 , see שְׂרָיָה . [ שׁוּר ] noun masculine wall (compare Biblical Hebrew II. שׁוּר id. ; Egyptian Aramaic שור RŠS 361A 5; B 1 ); — plural emphatic שׁוּרַיָּה Ezra 4:16 , אָ֯ 4:13 ; 4:12 read שׁ ׳שׁוּרַיָּא Qr, for אשׁ ׳שׁורי Kt.

occurrences.englishText: For by you, I run against a troop.
They make oil within the walls of these men.
